podcast.body: This song became a massive worldwide hit for Edwin Collins in 1994. "Edwin had a massive worldwide hit with this one in 1994. That's Edwin Collins and a girl like you."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This track is identified as Edwin Collins' major hit song from 1994. "Here's Edwin's big hit from 1994. Edwin Collins from 1994 with a girl like you."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: "A Girl Like You" by Edwin Collins was one of two legitimate hits from the soundtrack of the 1995 movie *Empire Records*. The film, starring Liv Tyler and Renée Zellweger, featured numerous tracks from the 80s and 90s, with 16 included on the soundtrack CD. "And there were two legitimate hits, till I hear it from you by the Jim Blossoms and a girl like you from Edwin Collins."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
